items.name: Lunge And Rotation
items.specific: Show the bottom of a forward lunge on the right leg: right foot planted forward, right knee bent, rear knee hovering above the floor, rear toes on floor. The athlete rotates the torso toward the right; both arms are straight at chest height, hands clasped together with interlaced fingers. Both hands and arms point 90 degrees sideways from the vertical plane containing the two legs, not in the same direction as the lunge. The head turns to look at the clasped hands. A front three-quarter view makes the right-angle rotation and both legs clear.
